A LITTLE GUIDANCE

Made part of
your everyday.

Caring for natural bamboo

Keep woven bamboo in a dry, ventilated place. Dust with a soft cloth or gentle brush. Avoid soaking and prolonged damp conditions. Let any lightly damp piece dry fully before storing.

A note on natural variation

Weave, colour and texture can differ between pieces. The collection uses workshop photos and an owner-supplied fan image, with selected photos enhanced for clarity. The Small Basket uses a labelled representative photo. Confirm the dimensions and finish before ordering.

How ordering works

  1. Explore the collection and add pieces to your bag.
  2. Submit an order request with your delivery details.
  3. Check My orders for owner approval and the final total, including delivery.
  4. After approval, choose Confirm & pay and use the merchant QR. Submit your UPI reference for manual receipt verification.

Listed prices were supplied by the owner. Ranges and unconfirmed units are finalised for your chosen specification. You can pay externally using our My orders & payment after the final total is confirmed. We verify receipt manually; this site does not confirm payment or an order automatically.

Delivery & returns

Please contact us to confirm delivery availability, charges, lead times and the return arrangements for your order before payment.

Your details

Your shopping bag is saved in this browser. Submitted order-request details are stored on the workshop server for owner review. Private tracking keys are saved in this browser. General enquiries are prepared on your device and shared only when you choose WhatsApp or email.
